title: What If the Space Station Fell Out of Orbit?

scenes.text: What if the International Space Station fell out of orbit? NASA plans to do exactly that.
Around 2030, a SpaceX vehicle worth up to 843 million dollars will push the station down.
It weighs about 430 metric tons, more than 900,000 pounds, and stretches 218 feet.
It would break apart on the way down, and the solar arrays and radiators burn up first.
Pieces as big as a small car are expected to survive and hit the ocean.
The target is a remote stretch of the South Pacific, far from any people.

description:
